mission: Build the mathematics corpus as a historical program in which equations, proofs, and methods carry origin stories and transmission paths.
organizing_rule: Important mathematical objects must later be teachable as both content and history.

eras.name: Antiquity
eras.focus: Number systems, arithmetic, geometric proof culture, and early rigorous work on magnitude and infinity.
canonical_works: Archimedes: On the Sphere and Cylinder
Theon of Alexandria: Euclid and Ptolemy commentary tradition
Hypatia: commentary tradition on Arithmetica and Conics
Eutocius of Ascalon: commentaries on Archimedes and Apollonius

proof_threads.title: Pythagorean theorem
proof_threads.story_focus: Why area relations in right triangles became a central proving tradition.

proof_threads.title: Euclidean proof architecture
proof_threads.story_focus: How definitions, common notions, and postulates shaped formal proof culture.

proof_threads.title: Archimedean exhaustion and infinite reasoning
proof_threads.story_focus: How finite geometric reasoning approached areas, volumes, and limiting processes.

equation_threads.title: Right-triangle square relation
equation_threads.story_focus: A relation later written algebraically, but born in geometric language.

eras.name: Medieval Transmission and Synthesis

Omar Khayyam: Demonstration concerning problems of algebra
Adelard of Bath: Euclid translation tradition

proof_threads.title: Algebra as a procedural science
proof_threads.story_focus: How equation solving emerged as a textual procedure before symbolic algebra matured.

proof_threads.title: Infinite series before early modern calculus
proof_threads.story_focus: How summation ideas and approximation traditions prepared later analysis.

equation_threads.title: Place-value numeration and written calculation

equation_threads.title: Quadratic equation procedures before modern symbolism

canonical_works: Leibniz: Nova Methodus pro Maximis et Minimis
Pascal and Fermat correspondence on games of chance
Cavalieri: Geometria indivisibilibus continuorum nova quadam ratione promota
Huygens: De Ratiociniis in Ludo Aleae

proof_threads.title: Fluxions and differentials

equation_threads.title: Differential notation

equation_threads.title: Integral sign lineage
equation_threads.story_focus: How accumulation became visually and conceptually encoded.

equation_threads.title: Early probability expressions
equation_threads.story_focus: How chance moved from concrete games to reusable mathematical language.

eras.focus: Rigor, abstraction, set-theoretic foundations, topology, formal probability, and computation.

Cauchy: Cours d'analyse de l'Ecole Royale Polytechnique
Galois: Memoire sur les conditions de resolubilite des equations par radicaux
Riemann: Ueber die Hypothesen welche der Geometrie zu Grunde liegen
Dedekind: Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen?
Peano: Arithmetices principia, nova methodo exposita
Cantor: Beitrage zur Begrundung der transfiniten Mengenlehre
Zermelo: Untersuchungen ueber die Grundlagen der Mengenlehre I

proof_threads.title: Rigorous analysis and limit language
proof_threads.story_focus: How calculus was rebuilt through convergence, continuity, and increasingly explicit proof standards.

proof_threads.title: Function representation and series methods
proof_threads.story_focus: How heat, waves, and functions became expressible through series, decomposition, and transform thinking.
required_artifacts: bridge to later spectral and signal methods

proof_threads.title: Equations, groups, and abstract algebra
proof_threads.story_focus: How solvability questions turned mathematics toward structure, symmetry, and algebraic objects.

proof_threads.title: Sets, numbers, and mathematical foundations
proof_threads.story_focus: How infinity, arithmetic, and formal systems became explicit mathematical objects of study.

proof_threads.title: Geometry beyond Euclid
proof_threads.story_focus: How space became manifold, topological, and axiomatic rather than only classical and metric.

proof_threads.title: Probability as an axiomatic theory

required_artifacts: bridge to statistics and stochastic models

proof_threads.title: Computability and formal limits
proof_threads.story_focus: How procedures, decidability, and the limits of formal reasoning became rigorous mathematical subjects.

equation_threads.title: Epsilon-delta language
equation_threads.story_focus: How limiting processes became explicit quantified mathematical statements.

equation_threads.title: Fourier series language
equation_threads.story_focus: How functions became representable through infinite trigonometric expansions.

equation_threads.title: Cardinality and transfinite notation
equation_threads.story_focus: How different sizes of infinity became explicit mathematical language.

equation_threads.title: Measure and probability language
equation_threads.story_focus: How area, measure, and chance entered a common formal notation.

collection_rules: Do not ingest later modern sources before each early era has a stable anchor set of works and figures.
Once the early eras are stable, add modern mathematics before attempting full cross-epoch networking.
For every proof thread, store at least one origin-oriented story summary and one mathematics-oriented proof summary.
For every equation thread, store origin, notation, and later standard form separately.
Treat transmission between cultures as first-class historical data, not as a footnote.
